irreducible_residue: 260 B/page uniform: single-line minification (no pretty-print option), data-next-head markers on all head tags, forced viewport meta, noscript data-n-css stub, __next hydration root, charSet/self-closing normalization; plus forced 404.html + 404/index.html and 14 dead JS chunks (~430 KB) in _next/ with zero client code
features_manual: sitemap.xml: hand-written generator script (scripts/prebuild.js) run before next build; pages router has no sitemap support, and the app-router sitemap.js convention emits a different pretty-printed multi-line format than the target
canonical + og:title/og:url/og:type: assembled by hand with next/head on every page (the app router Metadata API exists but forces app router's much heavier script/RSC-payload residue)
pretty-URL knowledge duplicated: href/canonical/sitemap URLs all hand-built as strings; trailingSlash: true only affects file layout
whitespace fidelity: explicit {'\n'} / {'\n  '} text nodes in JSX because React renders with zero formatting
conformance_checks: None. Next validates that getStaticPaths covers requested params (fallback: false errors on unknown paths at export) and fails the build on JSX/type errors, but nothing verifies internal links resolve, titles/canonicals are correct, or that sitemap matches emitted pages.
notes: Pages router chosen deliberately: unstable_runtimeJS: false removes ALL script tags and hydration JSON from the HTML, which the app router cannot do (app router always embeds the RSC payload + bootstrap scripts, hundreds of extra bytes-to-KB per page even with zero client components). Surprises: (1) install was fast for 'Next.js' fame — 54 packages, but 337 MB on disk (SWC/turbopack native binaries); (2) Next 16 pages router no longer emits <meta name=next-head-count> but now stamps data-next-head="" on every head tag instead — residue moved, didn't disappear; (3) React SSR inserts <!-- --> comments between adjacent text nodes, so the hand-placed newline text nodes had to be arranged so no two text nodes touch; (4) big build scaled superbly: 1901 pages in ~2.2s vs 7 pages in ~1.34s (~0.45ms/page marginal — parallel export workers); (5) compare.py flags unavoidable extra 404.html/404/index.html. Fidelity floor is exactly 15 diff lines/page (one-line head prelude + __next wrapper), 260 bytes/page overhead; body and sitemap are byte-exact.
